title: Irish stakeholders hail progress on ‘sex for rent’ legal crackdown
summary_en: Stakeholders in Ireland have welcomed progress on upcoming laws that will make 'sex for rent' a criminal offence, as the government moves to put an end to sexual harrassment when seeking housing.
author: Beth Kennedy
title_cn: Irish stakeholders hail progress on ‘sex for rent’ legal crackdown

title: How Australia is losing at international education
summary_en:
"Australia’s international education sector should be a global powerhouse, but there is instead a story of squandered promise," writes Felix Pirie, CEO of the
Independent Tertiary Education Council Australia (ITECA).
author: Felix Pirie
title_cn: How Australia is losing at international education

title: Australia maintains 2027 international student planning level at 295,000
summary_en: The Australian government keeps the National Planning Level unchanged at 295,000 after saying international student commencements are on track to remain below it, while confirming no active provider will receive a lower allocation in 2027.
author: Abhishek Nair
title_cn: Australia maintains 2027 international student planning level at 295,000

title: TNE drives UK export growth as international enrolment revenue slows
summary_en: The UK's total education exports grew modestly in 2024 to reach £36.7 billion, as the government eyes its target of £40 billion by the end of the decade.
author: Polly Nash
title_cn: TNE drives UK export growth as international enrolment revenue slows
